checks.comparison: PowerAssumption: ContinuousAt v t for a.e. t w.r.t. Lebesgue measure restricted to [0, inf), and IntervalIntegrable v on [0,T] for all T >= 0. Matches the accepted clause (a.e. continuous, integrable on bounded intervals).
valid: for all i, PowerAssumption (power i), whose first conjunct is v t >= 0 for t >= 0. Matches L867/L881.

admissible requires O = eventOracle (publicInput p) (fun i => work (power i)) P g with work v t = int_0^t v. eventOracle replies with the earliest completion, completion V s = inf{t >= s : V s + 1 <= V t}: the first time worker i has done one unit of work int_s^t v_i = 1 since its (re)start s. This realizes eq. L871 (floor of the work integral) with the accepted restart-loses-work reading.

deadline V S 0 = 0; deadline V S (k+1) = top if deadline k = top else roundTime V S (deadline k).toReal. Hence deadline (work/4) R K = T_K of L922/L924 with the infinity propagation convention. spec uses it at index ceil(48 L Delta/eps) = Kbar and threshold R.

roundTime V S s = ofReal(inf{t >= 0 : S <= sum_i floor(V_i t - V_i s)}) if the set is nonempty, else top. With V_i t = work(power i) t / 4 (as used in spec), floor(V_i t - V_i s) = floor(1/4 int_s^t v_i), so roundTime V R s = T(R, s) of L900 (top = +infinity for the empty set).
Justified by L881 and the accepted integrability interpretation.
Justified by L881.

publicInput: R = threshold sigma eps, gamma = stepSize L sigma eps R (same R), K = R * ceil(48 L Delta/eps); the deadline in successful uses the same R and Kbar and V_i = work(power i)/4; eventOracle uses V_i = work(power i). Consistent bindings.
successful is an implication: deadline < top -> (Measurable output /\ EpsStationary /\ a.s. ofReal clock <= deadline). Vacuous only when T_Kbar = +infinity (accepted).

Hypotheses: A1/A2 (SmoothLower), A3 (IsStochasticGradient + IID stream), MODU (PowerAssumption), T51/pos (valid). No arrival-order freedom: the oracle is pinned to the universal-model eventOracle. No strengthening.
threshold = max 1 ceil(sigma^2/eps) (L918); stepSize reused from setup_iter (L914 with sigma = 0 convention); Kbar = ceil(48 L Delta/eps) (L920); T_K via deadline with the 1/4 factor. Exact.
